build.title: Turino - A multi-agent system that monitors Turin municipal RSS feeds, classifies civic issues, and drafts responses for council review
build.description: Three specialized agents collaborate: a scraper agent monitors 10+ Turin city sources, a classifier agent routes items to departments using RAG over municipal documents, and a drafter agent generates Italian-language response letters. It demonstrates planning, tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and domain-specific RAG, impressing because it solves a real local problem and could actually be deployed.
